title: 第一卷 第5章 身上的腥味不少
content_zh:
私人会所。

    霍放一进包厢就听到调侃声。

    “不是英雄救美了吗？这会儿那女人识趣就该以身相许了。怎么不在温柔乡，还跑这里来了？”

    说话的是秦柯，这家高级私人会所的老板，也是雾城秦家的独子，身价千亿。

    另一人摇晃着红酒杯，是傅承言，房地产大佬，世界各地都有他的产业，身价不详。

    他语调轻淡，“才回国这么几天，就闹出这么大的动静，还动了刘昌。你也不怕给自己惹一身腥？”

    霍放拿起桌上的雪茄，闻了一下，“我身上的腥味还少吗？”

    秦柯震惊，“你不会玩真的吧？”

    “一个女人，至于让你这么大反应？”

    “女人不至于，但是能让你霍二少这么亲力亲为的女人，就至于了。”

    秦柯好奇，“什么来头？让你这么上心？”

    霍放拿起剪子剪掉帽盖，慢条斯理烤着底部，“自己送上门来的。”

    傅承言挑眉，和秦柯交换了视线。

    以前也有主动送上门的，他可没有这么玩过。

    “这么大张旗鼓，生怕别人不知道你俩的关系，是准备留着给亦可挡枪？”

    霍放薄唇含着雪茄，轻吸点燃，慢火慢烧，动作优雅。

    他吸了一口，烟入口片刻就吐了出来，手持雪茄，眼神慵懒。

    他不说话，却已经给了答案。

    秦柯大笑，“我就说嘛，亦可才是他心尖尖上的人。他怎么可能移情别恋？”

    傅承言看向霍放，淡淡说一句，“那姑娘可就惨了。”

    霍放脑子里浮出童喻那张脸。

    惨吗？

    她自找的。

    不是他强迫的。

    似乎，她更想要这样的效果。

    。

    童喻躺在狭窄的铁艺床上，睁着眼睛盯着天花板。

    脑子里全是霍放冲进来救她的画面。

    翻过身，床发出轻微晃动。

    没有哪个女人，在身陷困境之际被男人所救而不心动的。

    她也有那么一刻心动的感觉。

    但，她很清醒，霍放那样的男人，是桀骜不驯的鹰，身边最不缺女人。

    而她，只是送上门的食物。

    她为了生存，他则是为了娱乐。

    她不是特别的，顶多是觉得她有点意思，才对她有点兴趣。

    又或者，另有所图？

    童喻想不出来能在她身上图到什么。

    总之，她得抓住霍放。

    得让他一直对她有兴趣。

    认知异常清晰，童喻的心也终于静了下来，那些乱七八糟的情绪归于平静。

    手机震动，她拿过来看了眼，有两条信息，一条是银行发的入账信息，另一条是私教课程提醒。

    宋源给了童喻两万块的误工赔偿，并再三叮嘱她在家多休息。
content_en:
Private club.

    Huo Fang heard ridicule as soon as he entered the box.

    "Isn't he a hero who saves the beauty? Now that woman is wise enough to commit herself to her. Why are you not in Wenrou Township, and why are you here?"

    The speaker was Qin Ke, the owner of this high-end private club and the only son of the Qin family in Wucheng. He was worth hundreds of billions.

    The other person was shaking the red wine glass. He was Fu Chengyan, a real estate tycoon. He has properties all over the world and his net worth is unknown.

    His tone was light, "I have only been back to China for a few days, and yet I have made such a big fuss and even touched Liu Chang. Are you not afraid of making yourself smelly?"

    Huo Fang picked up the cigar on the table and smelled it, "Is there still less fishy smell on me?"

    Qin Ke was shocked, "You can't be serious, can you?"

    "A woman, why do you have such a big reaction?"

    "It's not a problem for a woman, but it's a woman who can make you, Mr. Huo, so hands-on."

    Qin Ke was curious, "What's the origin? What makes you so interested?"

    Huo Fang picked up the scissors and cut off the cap, roasting the bottom slowly, "I delivered it to my door."

    Fu Chengyan raised his eyebrows and exchanged glances with Qin Ke.

    I've had people come to my door on my own initiative before, but he's never played like this.

    "With such a big fanfare, you are afraid that others will not know about your relationship. Are you prepared to keep it or block the gun?"

    Huo Fang held the cigar between his thin lips, puffed lightly and lit it, then burned it slowly with graceful movements.

    He took a puff and spit out the cigarette a moment later, holding the cigar in his hand with lazy eyes.

    He didn't speak, but he already gave the answer.

    Qin Ke laughed, "Let me tell you, Yike is the one in his heart. How could he fall in love with someone else?"

    Fu Chengyan looked at Huo Fang and said lightly, "That girl is in trouble."

    Tong Yu's face came to Huo Fang's mind.

    Is it miserable?

    She asked for it.

    He didn't force it.

    It seems that she wants this effect more.

    .

    Tong Yu lay on the narrow wrought iron bed, staring at the ceiling with his eyes open.

    Her mind was full of images of Huo Fang rushing in to save her.

    Turning over, the bed shook slightly.

    There is no woman who would not be moved by a man when she is in trouble.

    She also felt excited for a moment.

    However, she is very clear-headed. A man like Huo Fang is an unruly eagle, and there is no shortage of women around him.

    And she just delivered food to her door.

    She does it for survival, he does it for entertainment.

    She's not special. At most, I think she's a little interesting, so I'm a little interested in her.

    Or maybe, you have other plans?

    Tong Yu couldn't think of anything he could picture in her.

    In short, she had to catch Huo Fang.

    She had to keep him interested.

    His cognition was extremely clear, and Tong Yu's heart finally calmed down, and those messy emotions calmed down.

    The phone vibrated, and she took it over to take a look. There were two messages, one was the account information sent by the bank, and the other was a personal training course reminder.

    Song Yuan gave Tong Yu 20,000 yuan in compensation for lost work, and repeatedly told her to rest at home.
